strings.header.title: AnduinOS Build Configurator
strings.header.subtitle: Graphical editor for args.sh  |  package customization  |  custom scripts  |  resume support
strings.language.label: Language
strings.dialog.open.title: Select args.sh
strings.msg.unsaved_open: There are unsaved changes. Open another file anyway?
strings.help.ubuntu_version: Target Ubuntu suite codename. The build host codename must match it.
strings.help.target_name: Lowercase, no spaces or special characters, e.g. anduinos. Used as the ISO identifier and output file name.
strings.help.build_version: Version string in x.y.z form (optionally with a suffix such as -beta1), e.g. 2.0.5.
strings.help.apt_source: Ubuntu mirror used to assemble the root filesystem; replace with any working mirror.
strings.help.apkg_server: APT server address for AnduinOS overlay packages.
strings.help.cert_name: GPG certificate name used to download and verify the repository from the APKG server.
strings.help.apt_config: APT configuration package name for AnduinOS sources (production / development).
strings.help.arch: Architecture of the generated ISO: amd64 (Intel/AMD 64-bit) or arm64 (ARM 64-bit).
strings.help.keep_debs: Strongly recommended. When enabled, .deb packages downloaded by apt are persisted in .cache/apt-archives/ under the project directory, so a rebuild with an unstable network can reuse them. This directory is not included in the final ISO.
strings.help.lang_packs: Space-separated language pack codes; expanded into language-pack-* packages at build time.
strings.help.regions: Live boot menu region entries, one per line: locale|label|timezone|XKB layout. Exactly 29 entries are required and validated by the build script.
strings.help.debian_frontend: Non-interactive package installation mode; usually keep noninteractive.
strings.help.lc_all: Locale of the build process, forced to English; independent of the languages selectable in the Live system.
strings.help.lang: Language setting of the build process.
strings.help.language: Language priority list of the build process.
strings.status.deb_toggle: Deb retention turned %(state)s; effective after saving
strings.msg.cache_empty: No .deb files in the cache directory.
strings.confirm.clear_cache: This will delete %(count)d .deb files (%(size)s). This cannot be undone. Continue?
strings.msg.clear_failed: Failed to clear the cache. Run manually: sudo rm -rf %(path)s
strings.pkg.intro: Check the packages to install; unchecked packages will be skipped. You can add extra package names. Changes are saved to packages.json in the project root and applied on the next build.
strings.pkg.col.name: Package
strings.err.duplicate_extra: "%(name)s" is already in the extra package list.
strings.hooks.intro: Enter custom commands / scripts here. The chroot script runs after rootfs customization and before leaving chroot; the pre-ISO script runs on the host once image/ is ready but before xorriso packaging.
strings.hooks.frame.pre_iso: Host script before ISO packaging (after image/ is ready)
strings.err.target_name: The short system name must be lowercase and contain only letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
strings.err.business_name: The display name cannot be empty.
strings.err.apt_source: The Ubuntu APT mirror cannot be empty.
strings.confirm.regions: The Live region policy currently has %(count)d entries; the build script requires 29. Save anyway?
strings.dialog.save_as.title: Save Configuration As
strings.dialog.build.title: Choose Build Mode
strings.dialog.build.text:
Configuration saved. Choose a build mode:

Fresh build: clean old artifacts and build from scratch
Resume from interruption: skip completed stages, useful after a script error
strings.log.title: AnduinOS Build Log
strings.buildcmd.text:
After saving the configuration, run in the project directory:

  cd %(dir)s && make

If the script fails midway, resume from the interruption:

  cd %(dir)s && ./build.sh --resume

You can also click "Save Configuration & Start Build" in the GUI.
strings.info.title: Information
strings.log.failed: Build failed (exit code %(code)d); you can resume
strings.log.failed_append: >>> Build failed. Click "Resume from Interruption" to continue.
strings.confirm.close_running: The build is still running. Close and terminate it?
strings.status.legacy_upgrade: Legacy config detected: "Keep downloaded .deb packages" enabled by default. Save to apply.
